tearooms_server.text: Sit anywhere, cariad. Cariad means darling. Everyone in Pembrokeshire is cariad until they leave a gate open.
Bara brith means speckled bread. The fruit soaks overnight in tea, so by morning it is plump as a puffling.

then.text: Another slice? You will sink the boat. Off you go, cariad.

else.text: Here, a slice for the road. You look like you have walked the coast path, or at least thought about it.
